name: Chromium Beta
author: The Chromium Authors
description: Chromium is a free and open-source web browser project, principally developed and maintained by Google. Having a modern browser port for ARM32 is an absolute game changer, allowing you to browse modern web pages on older Windows RT devices.
instructionSteps: Ecureuil will automatically execute the setup installer.
This version works better on 10 arm32
